C-FIX-012-ACTIVE-BLOCK-ANCESTRY.Name: Stop active-block ancestry at a missing parent
C-FIX-012-ACTIVE-BLOCK-ANCESTRY.Summary: Implement the attributed FIX-012 repair in Muya ContentState: when a transient cursor block names a parent no longer present in the block index, return the valid active prefix and never append undefined for the renderer to dereference.
C-FIX-012-ACTIVE-BLOCK-ANCESTRY.Problem: The failing full command walk was reduced to file.new-tab, help.guide, then tabs.cycleForward. getActiveBlocks resolves a missing parent and unconditionally pushes the undefined result; StateRender.getSelector then reads b.key during the tab-triggered render.
C-FIX-012-ACTIVE-BLOCK-ANCESTRY.ApprovalBasis: This is the narrow attributed implementation companion to the owner-approved C-FIX-012-TAB-CYCLE-RENDER bundle. That approved plan did not list ContentState as an observed write, so this bundle preserves immutable-plan discipline instead of silently expanding it.

Goals.Goal: Return only real blocks from getActiveBlocks, in leaf-to-root order.
Keep the exact Guide-then-cycle reproducer and the full affordance walk free of render exceptions.

Constraints.Constraint: Stop only when ancestry cannot be resolved; do not synthesize blocks, mutate the cursor, catch renderer exceptions or change valid parent traversal.

NonGoals.NonGoal: No Guide content rewrite, tab UX change, Windows/Linux-specific work, release or publication.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: A missing immediate or deeper parent ends traversal and the returned array contains no nullish member.
Valid multi-level ancestry remains leaf-to-root and unchanged.
file.new-tab → help.guide → tabs.cycleForward and the full registry walk emit no TypeError; the FIX-012 warning allowance remains removed.

VerificationIntent.ExpectedEvidence: Unit ancestry boundary plus exact reduced and full browser reproductions.
